title: Singleton accuracy value
statement: Let $t$ be a positive rational and let $\varepsilon$ be rational with $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$. Define $D=\lceil 8t/\varepsilon\rceil$ and $T=(\varepsilon/8)^2t^{-2}(1/9)^D$. The singleton influence accuracy is exactly $\min(T/4,1/2)$.
